parsed.rationale: The two initializers — `NowPlayingEntry.init(_:)` in `app:WatchXYC` (PlayerPage.swift:173) and `NowPlayingTimelineEntry.init(nowPlayingItem:recentItems:family:)` in `app:iOS` (NowPlayingWidget/NowPlayingTimelineEntry.swift:24) — serve structurally similar but platform-distinct purposes: one feeds a watchOS Now Playing UI entry and the other feeds an iOS WidgetKit timeline entry. Their Jaccard similarity of 0.78 reflects shared domain vocabulary (now-playing data) rather than shared logic, and their differing signatures (`_:` vs `nowPlayingItem:recentItems:family:`) confirm they accept different inputs for different platform APIs. Merging or extracting a common initializer would couple watchOS and iOS widget targets, which are intentionally separate packages (`app:WatchXYC` vs `app:iOS`), without meaningful reduction in complexity.
